Sam: FYI we're doing a region-split staggered rollout of llmroute-v4 tomorrow 04:30 UTC. New plan: split traffic by region cohorts (prod-us / prod-eu) then merge. Flag: `llmroute_v4_region_split`. Will create cohorts `us-seed` and `eu-seed`. Primary safety knobs: regional holds + model-variant fallback before full pin.

Mei: Love the split approach. Proposed weights: US: 0.5% -> 4% (hold 20m) -> 20% -> 70% -> 100%. EU: wait for US to pass 20% then start: 0.5% -> 5% (hold 20m) -> 25% -> 75% -> 100%. At each holdpoint we run the perf and quality gates.

Carlos: Additional mitigation: try quantized fallback first (llmroute-v4-q4) if latency or cost spikes. Only if fallback also fails do we pin to v3. That gives a middle-ground instead of immediate revert.

Sam: Good idea. Add automated fallback logic: threshold breach -> switch cohort to v4-q4 for 5m; if metrics don't improve -> reduce cohort to 1% for 5m; if still bad -> pin to v3 and notify oncall.

Mei: Metrics to post at each holdpoint: p50/p95 latency, 1m error rate, tokens per request, token_cost_per_1k, and a random sample of 10 prompts with outputs for QA review (redacted).

Carlos: Runbook snippet:```
# create region cohorts and seed
rb ff create-cohort llmroute_v4_region_split us-seed --region prod-us
rb ff create-cohort llmroute_v4_region_split eu-seed --region prod-eu
rb ff set llmroute_v4_region_split --cohort us-seed --weight 0.5
# fallback to quantized variant
rb ff set llmroute_variant --cohort us-seed --model llmroute-v4-q4
# quick pin to stable
rb ff set llmroute_v4_region_split --cohort global --weight 0
rb route set default --model llmroute-v3
```

Sam: Decision gates at each step: if p95 delta > 90ms OR error_rate >0.6% OR cost_per_1k +25% -> trigger fallback-to-q4. If fallback doesn't reduce p95 by at least 30% within 5m -> follow reduce->pin path. Also watch top-20 user queries for semantic regressions.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout for llmroute_v4_region_split at 2025-10-02T04:30:00Z. Cohorts created: us-seed(id: r-us-12a), eu-seed(id: r-eu-3b7). Preflight snapshot attached: p50=46ms p95=128ms token_cost_per_1k=$0.39 cpu_avg=28%. Will post holdpoint reports and attempt automated q4 fallback before pin.

Mei: Please ensure deploy-bot tags any automated actions with `rollback:autofallback` or `rollback:autopin` and posts the triggering metric line. Also add a one-line human-readable rationale for any automated pin.

Carlos: Release note draft to include: "llmroute v4 (region-split rollout) 3: improved contextual reranking; staged by region with quantized fallback option. See rollout playbook and rollback commands." Link: https://redwood.example.com/releases/llmroute-v4-region-split.

Sam: Ops checklist for the window: 1) confirm preflight snapshot at 04:00 UTC, 2) ensure CS pager/ops channel is primed, 3) SRE oncall watches tail latencies, 4) QA reviews sample prompts at each holdpoint. If any holdpoint fails, follow the automated mitigation flow and then escalate.

oncall-bot: Acknowledged. Will monitor tail latencies and notify #eng-oncall. If automated pin occurs, opening an incident stub with tag `rollback:autofallback` and paging the oncall rotation.

Mei: I'll be watching the US seed holds. Carlos, Sam please be ready to run the pin commands if onboarding fallback fails.

Carlos: Standing by. Sam: I'll post a final short release note into #release-notes once deploy-bot posts the preflight. :white_check_mark:
